profile.summary: AI engineer with 3+ years across machine learning, LLM systems, and production Python backends. I turn ambiguous business problems into grounded RAG workflows, dependable APIs, and measurable improvements in reliability and latency.

highlights: Built and maintained FastAPI services ingesting five-minute vessel data for more than 400 vessels.
Restructured the backend into controller, service, and repository layers to make features easier to build and test.
Optimized PostgreSQL access and introduced post-RBAC caching, cutting retrieval latency by 97% from roughly 5 seconds to 200 milliseconds.
Deployed hardened services on AWS with Docker, Nginx, rate limiting, and restricted network rules.
Designed and shipped a RAG-powered WhatsApp customer assistant serving more than 100 users.
Benchmarked four LLM approaches on accuracy, latency, maintainability, and hallucination rate before selecting the production stack.
Re-architected the assistant as a tool-calling ReAct agent after diagnosing hallucination and tool-selection failures.
Built FastAPI and Azure webhook automation that reduced the team’s routine manual workload by 90%.

experience.company: Doctoral Institute for Evidence-Based Policy, Inc.
highlights: Benchmarked rule-based minutiae matching, CNN classifiers, and Siamese networks for fingerprint classification, reaching 95% accuracy.
Developed end-to-end BERT workflows for Japanese sentiment analysis, reaching approximately 80% binary accuracy.
Resolved half-width and full-width Unicode inconsistencies across large Japanese datasets.
Built reusable preprocessing and visualization tools and supported production web integration with engineering teams in Japan.
